description: This file contains FastAPI application code with dependency injection, route handlers, and test cases for different dependency behaviors, including caching and security scopes.

methods.name: dep_counter()
methods.description: Asynchronous dependency that increments and returns a counter to track dependency calls.

methods.name: super_dep(count: int = Depends(dep_counter))
methods.description: Async dependency that depends on dep_counter and returns its count.

methods.name: get_counter(count: int = Depends(dep_counter))
methods.description: Route handler that returns the current count from dep_counter.

methods.name: get_sub_counter( subcount: int = Depends(super_dep), count: int = Depends(dep_counter) )
methods.description: Route handler that returns a sub-counter and main counter, demonstrating dependency chaining.

methods.name: get_sub_counter_no_cache( subcount: int = Depends(super_dep), count: int = Depends(dep_counter, use_cache=False), )
methods.description: Route handler similar to get_sub_counter but disables caching for dep_counter dependency.

methods.name: get_scope_counter( count: int = Security(dep_counter), scope_count_1: int = Security(dep_counter, scopes=["scope"]), scope_count_2: int = Security(dep_counter, scopes=["scope"]), )
methods.description: Route handler that demonstrates dependency injection with security scopes.

methods.name: test_normal_counter()
methods.description: Test function that verifies the counter increments for /counter/ endpoint.

methods.name: test_sub_counter()
methods.description: Test function that verifies sub-counter increments under /sub-counter/ endpoint.

methods.name: test_sub_counter_no_cache()
methods.description: Test for dependency Caching behavior in /sub-counter-no-cache/ endpoint.

methods.name: test_security_cache()
methods.description: Test function that verifies security scope dependencies are functioning correctly.
